ai_summary: India Shelter Finance Corporation reported a strong Q1 FY26, achieving robust 34% YoY AUM growth and a 43% YoY increase in Profit After Tax, leading to an improved ROE of 17.2% driven by expanding margins and operational efficiencies. A key red flag is the notable deterioration in early delinquency metrics, with 30+ DPD increasing by 100 basis points to 4.5% due to seasonality and broader macroeconomic softness, alongside a slight uptick in Stage 3 assets. While management maintains its credit cost guidance and expects stabilization, this trend warrants close monitoring against their maintained aggressive loan growth targets.
